subject: Film & Cinema
title: Indie Animation: Voices from the Margins
description: Learn Indie Animation: Voices from the Margins in one minute.

hook.text: You don't need a studio to make animation anymore. A laptop and patience can produce a masterpiece.

buildup.text: Indie animators use crowdfunding, festivals, and social media to reach audiences directly.

discovery.text: Wolfwalkers and The Breadwinner proved tiny studios can compete with Disney at the Oscars.

twist.text: Most indie animators work for years on a single project — passion sustains what money cannot.

climax.text: Independent animation keeps the medium diverse, experimental, and honest.

punchline.text: The smallest teams tell the biggest stories.

quiz.question: How do indie animators typically fund their work?
options: Crowdfunding, festivals, and social media reach
